saw_lines: Clinic owners rarely switch software on a whim. They compare the trial, the price, and whether it fits their bookings.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, since a new buyer has no reason to start a trial.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 2 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
ads_1: Lead with the first order discount, two short lines, then the free trial
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
